# The address-collection regression reaches the send side effect

The list-reply browser test sends through the mock SMTP path, waits for aftersend and inspects the collected card, then awaits composer closure. This tests the send-stage side effect more directly than opening a composer. It remains inspected test code: no SMTP mock, window closure or address-book mutation ran in this history pass. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mail/test/browser.
